name: microsoft/SizeBench
purpose: Analyze and compare code and data size in Windows PE binaries | Tool using binary and PDB pairs; useful for EXE DLL and SYS size regressions

name: microsoft/binskim
purpose: Check compiler linker and security-relevant binary characteristics | Binary analyzer with SARIF output; rules and supported formats depend on version

name: microsoft/vcperf
purpose: Capture MSVC compiler and linker performance traces | C++ Build Insights tool; integrates with Windows Performance Analyzer

name: microsoft/cpp-build-insights-samples
purpose: Examples of finding compilation and code-generation bottlenecks | SDK sample resource rather than a standalone runtime

name: microsoft/clrmd
purpose: Inspect .NET processes and memory dumps programmatically | Microsoft.Diagnostics.Runtime.dll; validate supported CLR and library major version

name: rainers/cv2pdb
purpose: Convert supported CodeView or DWARF debug information to PDB | Specialized converter; validate compiler output and debug-record coverage
